the_saving.claim: A reader who takes the trace instead of the record reads about 6k tokens instead of about 40k: roughly a seventh. The saving repeats for every agent that reads it (each visualiser, the journalist, the accountant), and again on every turn the material stays in context.
the_saving.basis: reporter.newsroom@'s own estimate of the record it read (about 40k) against the trace's size (about 6k)
the_saving.label: analysis, from two estimates; not measured
